objective: Test transfer of the no-fit real-gas pressure-driven thermal model on three public hydrogen-cylinder depressurization experiments.

correction.reason: The same three YAML files and their numerical outcomes had already been accessed through the Zenodo reproducibility archive. The GitHub path is another copy, not a new holdout.

known_before_freeze: the public manual describes three hydrogen runs with approximately 30 s, 480 s and 14 s depressurization durations
the public manual states a 0.0499 m3 Type-I cylinder and identifies pressure plus upper and lower gas-temperature observations
the repository file names and v0.50.0 commit were known
correction: the same numerical files had previously been accessed through a separately named Zenodo archive

locked_model.pressure_role: measured boundary; pressure is not predicted and earns no pressure-validation claim
locked_model.temperature_model: HEOS hydrogen open-system energy balance with a lumped wall and Churchill-Chu natural-convection heat transfer
locked_model.configuration_rule: Use only non-validation YAML sections for geometry, wall properties, ambient conditions and heat-transfer settings. Do not infer a parameter from measured temperature arrays.

frozen_mapping.unit_rule: Accept only units explicitly stated by the YAML/manual or unambiguous SI magnitudes; otherwise retain an ineligible metadata result.
frozen_mapping.time_alignment: Use published timestamps without an optimized time shift. Interpolate the measured pressure monotonically with PCHIP onto the union of temperature timestamps within pressure support.

requires: finite strictly increasing pressure and temperature time arrays
upper and lower gas-temperature units resolved
positive wall heat capacity or sufficient wall properties to calculate it
eligibility.failure_policy: Invalidate the prospective claim when prior access is discovered; retain an ineligible result without substituting channels, fitting geometry or replacing a selected file.

claim_boundary: A pass supports pressure-driven bulk thermal response for three public Type-I hydrogen depressurization traces. It does not validate pressure prediction, valve or line flow, Type-III/IV tanks, station control, dispersion, fire, radiation, separation distance or emergency-response effectiveness.
